bots.reaction: If I think I'm the spy
bots.help.voice: How your bot talks: its tone and personality. It changes the wording only, not the strategy.
bots.help.style: How your bot describes its secret word. This is the biggest thing deciding how easy its clues are to read.
bots.help.quirk: A small habit added to every statement. It makes a bot recognisable, and can also give it away.
bots.help.words: How long the clues are, from a few words to one detailed sentence. More detail helps teammates guess, but it also gives the spy more to copy.
bots.help.form: A creative constraint on the shape of each clue, like a riddle or emoji only. One word and Emoji only override wordiness.
bots.help.think: How hard the bot thinks before it speaks. Instinct answers straight away. Careful checks its word against what others said. Deep adds a separate analysis step first and uses it to choose its vote. Deep uses more AI calls and a little more time.
bots.help.suspicion: How easily the bot decides it might be the spy. Higher means it gets suspicious sooner. Only used by Deep thinking.
bots.help.reaction: What the bot does when it suspects it is the spy, meaning its word doesn't fit the clues. Only used by Careful and Deep thinking; an Instinct bot never notices.
bots.help.rules: Up to 3 if-then tactics. Pick a situation, then what the bot does in it. For example: when I am accused, vote for who voted for me.
bots.words.5.desc: One detailed sentence, as much as fits.
bots.suspicion.1.desc: Trusting: hardly ever thinks it might be the spy.
bots.suspicion.5.desc: Paranoid: suspects it is the spy at the slightest mismatch.
bots.voice.dry.desc: Deadpan and understated, with little enthusiasm.
bots.voice.chatty.desc: Friendly and rambly, with small tangents.
bots.voice.terse.desc: Short, clipped sentences with no fluff.
bots.voice.grandma.desc: Warm and doting, fond of calling people "dear".
bots.voice.sleepy_cat.desc: Drowsy and lazy, easily distracted by naps and sunbeams.
bots.style.concrete.desc: Physical details: shape, size, material, where it is found. Clear clues that teammates and the spy can both follow.
bots.style.vague.desc: Abstract, indirect hints with no physical detail. Harder to read, for good or ill.
bots.style.metaphor.desc: Compares the word to something else.
bots.style.memory.desc: Describes the word through a tiny personal memory.
bots.style.contrast.desc: Says what the word is unlike or the opposite of.
bots.quirk.question.desc: Ends every statement with a question.
bots.quirk.agree.desc: Starts by agreeing with the previous speaker.
bots.quirk.number.desc: Puts a number in digits into every statement.
bots.quirk.emoji.desc: Ends every statement with one emoji.
bots.quirk.color.desc: Mentions a colour in every statement.
bots.form.plain.desc: No special shape: a normal clue.
bots.form.riddle.desc: Phrases the clue as a small riddle.
bots.form.rhyme.desc: Phrases the clue as a short rhyming couplet.
bots.form.one_word.desc: Answers with a single word. Overrides wordiness.
bots.form.emoji_only.desc: Answers with emoji only and no words. Overrides wordiness.
bots.form.question_only.desc: Phrases the whole clue as a question.
bots.think.instinct.desc: Answers straight away with one AI call. Never works out whether it might be the spy.
bots.think.careful.desc: Still one AI call, but first compares its word with what others said. If it clearly doesn't fit, it uses its spy reaction.
bots.think.deep.desc: Adds a separate analysis step before speaking: scores how well its word fits, and uses Suspicion to judge whether it is probably the spy. Also guides its vote. Uses more AI calls and a little more time.
bots.reaction.blend_in.desc: Gives generic, safe clues that fit almost any related word.
bots.reaction.go_vague.desc: Gives hints too fuzzy for anyone to pin on it.
bots.reaction.mirror.desc: Echoes the theme the other clues share, without specifics of its own word.
bots.reaction.deflect.desc: Questions or casts doubt on another player to shift attention.
